topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I get home, and there they are—flowers, just plopped on the kitchen table, no note, no nothing. Who does this? Sending flowers without saying a damn word? Do they think I’m supposed to be some sort of mind reader? I don’t need vague gestures and pointless gifts. I’d rather have a straight conversation, not these dumb, confusing acts. I’m not impressed; I’m just left wondering what the hell the point was. If they wanted to say something, why not just say it? Now, I’m stuck here, staring at these flowers, feeling like I’ve been played some kind of ridiculous game.
